message.reasoning:
I need to decide whether to bid on B&O Railroad in this auction.

I have $413 cash and a red monopoly. Bidding $200 would leave me with $213, which is too little to cover a Connecticut hotel at $600. Mortgaging the railroad I just bought would barely cover that gap. The next roll cannot reach light blue spaces, but hitting them one lap later would be game-losing.

B&O alone does not complete a set or block another color monopoly. p4 has two railroads and $739, so they will pay for a third. I should drop out. Bidding $201 or more is too expensive. p1 is bidding $200 to stop p4 from getting a cheap third railroad. Short Line is still unowned.

p1 has no railroads, so winning at $200 would not give them a set. They already own light blue hotels and would be drained of cash. If I drop out, p4 might raise the bid above $200 to take the property from p1.
